entities.summary: Vinko Jelovac is a Slovenian-Croatian former professional basketball player and coach. At a height of 2.08 m tall, and a weight of 120 kg (260 lb), he played at the center position. Jelovac was named Slovenian Sportsman of the Year in 1973 and 1974. Jelovac who is the all-time leading scorer in the history of the Yugoslav First Federal League. He was inducted into the Slovenian Athletes Hall of Fame, in 2012.
